generated_note: Bloody Marys, Bloody Marias and Caesars within about 1.5 miles of the Drury Plaza Hotel Milwaukee Downtown (700 N Water St; 43.0389, -87.9089). Researched Oct 23, 2026 for the mornings of Sat Oct 24, Sun Oct 25 and Mon Oct 26. Ranked by how much fun they'd be for two friends the morning after a show. Walking times are straight-line distance x1.25 at about 20 minutes per mile. Coordinates and Google star ratings come from Google Places; hours come from venue sites and Google and should be rechecked the morning of. The Milwaukee Public Market (400 N Water St, 6 minutes away, opens 10 AM) holds five of these places and about 15 bloodies, so it works as a one-stop bloody crawl. Earliest openers: Café Benelux 7 AM; Sweet Diner 7:30 AM; Tre Rivali brunch, Uncle Wolfie's and Catrina 8 AM; Wicked Hop 9 AM (Sat/Sun). For Monday before a 3 PM flight: Benelux, Uncle Wolfie's, Sweet Diner, Catrina and the Public Market are open in the morning; Wicked Hop opens at 11. No Halloween- or World Series-specific hour changes were found; Halloween is next Saturday (Oct 31). Yelp blocks automated fetching, so every yelp_url is null. Photo refs point to article pages, not image files.
